comments.author: Northerner
comments.body:
Fame req for this is only about 8k. If you can pull the first one, you can assuredly pull this one. If you meet all the reqs, it'll show eventually, but one important caveat for these quests for mid (FSD and Leshan):

If you're in fleet with someone who has already done them, they won't show no matter how many QMP you spend.

I ran into that problem with someone, though I was the one to do the quest first. He had to unfleet, then it showed on the first QMP.

comments.author: Northerner
comments.body:
H9376 is either trolling, or completely ignorant of how this game works. All but the most beginner quests have a fame requirement, and this is verifiable on the Taiwanese and Korean wikis. The information is out there, it's just a matter of wading through machine translation to get it.

To quote myself:

"47k is for upper (46k for Leshan). Both of the mid quests are MUCH less, 8k verified for one, and a similar amount for the other."

This quest needs around 7.5k or 8k fame. It's the quests for the upper levels of each EA dungeon that are the pain in the ass, with 46k and 47k requirements. I can confirm that this quest will show without the language req, but if it doesn't, you'll waste less QMPs by having the language. It's mainly the job quests (and some of their prequests) that are real sticklers about having all possible reqs, including language.
